title: Face Sculpt Contour Group #013 (2인 · 듀오 · 극단 1 + 원래 1 · 체리 립 + 최극단·사과볼+보조개 · 정면 · 3:4 세로 · 배경 순흑 기본 · 귀 대형 귀걸이 / 단일 금속 추(청동))
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, vertical portrait-orientation close-up beauty portrait. TWO women standing close together, shoulders touching, each facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, heads level, both ears of every woman clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of their heads down to the line of their shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the weights and the long earrings fully hang in view. Every face is large and sharp. All of them stand together in one single shared scene, in one row in front of the same continuous background, and this is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, not a collage: the women overlap slightly in depth and the background runs unbroken behind all of them.

#1: A striking adult Chinese woman — Chinese fresh natural beauty deeply sun-tanned bronze-brown skin with a warm natural sheen and real visible pores, mid 20s, glossy dark-brown loose waves past the shoulders, thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, silver glitter lines across the lids, heavy black liner, very long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, small rhinestone stickers on the cheeks only, vivid pure opaque white coloured contact lenses with a greatly enlarged dilated pupil, both eyes the same, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, round bright eyes opened wide and sparkling, brows raised a little, lips slightly parted, gazing straight at the camera with eager interest, a curious, inquisitive expression — a photograph of a real Chinese woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with a few small natural beauty marks and freckles, an uneven natural skin tone with a faint flush across the cheeks and around the nostrils, tiny visible pores on the nose and chin and fine natural vertical lines in the lips, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, real wet catchlights in the eyes, individual hair strands catching the light. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her lips are the star of her face (the shape, size and projection described here override the lips of her makeup, while the lip colours follow the colour plan stated at the end of this clause, replacing the lip colour of her makeup, and the finish is glossy): 'cherry lips': the fullness concentrated in the centre of the upper and lower lips, forming a rounded, plump, pouty cherry-shaped mouth with the corners left slim and untouched, glossy, youthful, sweet and symmetrical; her lips are painted in 4 different flat solid colours with crisp, straight, clean boundaries between them: the mouth is divided into 4 vertical bands from left to right, metallic gold, lavender, burgundy and ruby red, each band running across both the upper and the lower lip, every block fully opaque and glossy. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

#1 Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about nine in total (not counting the hanging drops), spread over every area so that no area is empty: one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, the lower opening holding a gigantic multi-tier waterfall chandelier earring, a large classic round O-ring hoop in the lobe with three stacked tiers of marquise and teardrop gem drops cascading from it, each tier wider than the last, as wide as her palm and as long as her hand, hanging freely in the air down to the level of her collarbone and no lower, and the upper opening holding a large classic round hoop earring, and above them sit three thick classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim above the lobe; one small stud across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; one small stud along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. Henna: fine metallic gold henna mehndi line patterns of vines and dots are painted across the upper forehead near the hairline only, above the forehead studs, well clear of the eyes and brows.

#2: A striking adult Chinese woman — Chinese fresh natural beauty milky ivory-fair complexion with a cool-neutral undertone and real visible pores, mid 20s, glossy dark-brown loose waves past the shoulders, wet-look glass skin glowing as if coated in clear gel, strong liquid highlighter on the cheekbones, nose bridge and the center of the forehead, a flushed rosy blush, high-shine glossy lips, odd-eyed with two clearly different lenses: her left eye has an ice-blue coloured contact lens with a heart-shaped pupil, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, and her right eye has a vivid emerald-green coloured contact lens with a greatly enlarged dilated pupil, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, the two eye colours both bright and clearly different from each other, a piercing direct stare, jaw set, lips firmly closed, a bold, commanding, fierce expression — a photograph of a real Chinese woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with a few small natural beauty marks and freckles, an uneven natural skin tone with a faint flush across the cheeks and around the nostrils, tiny visible pores on the nose and chin and fine natural vertical lines in the lips, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, real wet catchlights in the eyes, individual hair strands catching the light. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her lips are the star of her face (the shape, size and projection described here override the lips of her makeup, while the lip colours follow the colour plan stated at the end of this clause, replacing the lip colour of her makeup, and the finish is glossy): the absolute extreme of 'Russian lips', a cartoon-doll mouth made real: the upper lip pressing right up against the base of her nose and the lower lip reaching the very tip of her chin, so the whole mouth is one enormous, glossy, perfectly symmetrical dome and by far the biggest thing on her face; and her eyes are also pushed to the extreme, as a second star of her face: pure fantasy eyes about ten times their natural length and far taller and rounder than normal: the inner corners fully opened with the small pink inner corners visible, the outer corners sweeping across her temples, past her ears and into the hairline, two colossal almond-shaped eyes each with a huge round iris and a clean sweep of white on both sides, symmetrical and graceful, a fine eyeliner in the colour of her makeup ending in a long point swept up above each ear, in very large doll-eye contact lenses with a glossy shine, a round natural pupil and bright catchlights; and her nose is also sculpted to the extreme, a third star of her face: the most extreme surgical nose imaginable: an extremely tall, knife-edged bridge, a long needle-pointed tip projecting far forward and tilted slightly upward, and nostril wings pinched to thin slit-like nostrils; and her facial contour is her own, a fourth star of her face (the contour described here sets the whole outline of her face, meaning the forehead, cheeks, jawline and chin): her hair is swept back behind both ears so the entire outline of her face is clearly visible; plump apple cheeks: full, round, high-set cheeks that swell outward under the eyes like two apples and lift into soft round domes with a bright highlight on each, a short soft rounded jaw below them, and a pair of deep, clearly visible dimples in both cheeks beside the corners of the mouth; her lips are painted in 4 different flat solid colours with crisp, straight, clean boundaries between them: the mouth is divided into 4 slanted bands by straight parallel lines tilted at about forty-five degrees and leaning to the right, from left to right violet purple, lime green, burgundy and metallic silver, each band cutting diagonally across both the upper and the lower lip, every block fully opaque and glossy. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

#2 Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about nine in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; on each ear, three separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below another with a clear gap of bare skin between each, each opening holding its own very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above them sit three thick classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim above the lobe; one small stud across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; one small stud along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. Henna: fine metallic gold henna mehndi line patterns of vines and dots are painted across the upper forehead near the hairline only, above the forehead studs, well clear of the eyes and brows. The face and ear jewelry is real mixed yellow gold, silver and rose gold set with glossy multicoloured enamel and rainbow gemstones. Her lips and chin carry no piercing at all, so the shape of her lips stays completely clear and unobstructed. Her ear weights are all dark patinated bronze, each a different shape.

Ear weights, for the women who wear weights in their lobes: On each ear of every woman who wears weights, all six weights hang from her iron rings in staggered columns, each weight on its own thick chain of heavy links of the same metal as the weight, the chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is a massive, dense, solid, squat, blunt lump of rough, matte, unpolished heavy metal, in the metal named in her own paragraph, at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, with no thin parts, no arms and no hollow parts; the last weight is as big and heavy-looking as the first, each chain pulled bar-straight and taut, the long chains hanging freely in the air, clear of the neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of the collarbones. Because the load is carried by her iron rings, the weight gently pulls each earlobe down a little into a slightly elongated, soft, healthy loop of skin, only a small natural droop that is just enough to show how heavy the weights are; no lobe stretches long, tears or collapses or hangs down to the neck or shoulder, every head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness.

Earrings: the large earrings of the women who wear them hang freely in the air down to the level of the collarbone and no lower, and no earring of one woman hangs in front of another woman's face.

All piercings: Each woman wears only the piercings named in her own paragraph, in those places and nowhere else; on every woman the eyes, eyelids and eyebrows stay completely clear. All jewelry is real metal, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar is embedded in the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface; every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden, all of them passing through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around them.

Hair: every woman's hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, jawlines and necks fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Pose: each woman stands upright, arms relaxed at her sides, heads level, shoulder to shoulder and close enough that their shoulders and upper arms touch or slightly overlap in depth, leaning very slightly toward each other, so that the hanging pieces of one never hang in front of another and each woman's hanging pieces stay in front of her own shoulder. They all share one single continuous pitch-black background behind them, with no separate panels, no split screen, no borders and no different backgrounds behind different women. There is no dividing line between the women, and no different light, colour or background on different women.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. One single light setup lights everyone from the same direction with the same colour, so the shadows and highlights match on every woman. A soft frontal light on all the faces and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 3:4 vertical 8K.
